out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed open drinks stored in the employee only shelf near the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CFM removed all open beverages.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed back handwashing sink, handwashing sink in the bar area and handwashing sink in the sushi area without soap
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM provided soap at handwashing sinks during inspection.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. Observed Clams tags were not marked with the date the last shellstock from the container was sold or served.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. CFM marked shellstock tags with the last date sold or served and will retain records for 90 days

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed potato salad below raw shrimp, raw shell eggs in unit # 1 and raw shrimp on top of parsley in unit # 5
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated potato salad to the left shelf whit all RTE foods in unit # 1, and relocated raw shrimp to the bottom shelf. KUMO ASIAN BISTRO (Inspection Date: 06/11/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Observed tempura crunch stored in the back ares without covered waste.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. Employee covered all 4 containers of Tempura crunch

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean between Raw Animal Foods
violations.observation: Equipment food contact surfaces/utensils were not observed cleaned before each use with a different type of raw animal food. Observed two tongs used for, raw chicken, raw beef, raw shrimp, cooked pork, cooked chicken
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned before each use with a different type of raw animal food such as beef, fish, lamb, pork, or poultry. CFM provided tongs for each fro raw animals of different types and RTE foods.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Eel in toaster oven at 128F, Shrimp tempura on strainer at 115F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19.CFM discarded Eel, relocated Shrimp tempura to cooler.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed Bean sprouts, bagged bean sprouts, cut lettuce, pink sauce in unit # 4 at 45, 55, 56, 45F, Imitation crab, grilled mushrooms, raw shrimp, raw beef, raw chicken in unit # 5 at 61, 56, 61, 45, 45F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Bean sprouts, bagged bean sprouts, cut lettuce, pink sauce from unit # 4, Imitation crab, grilled mushrooms, raw shrimp, raw beef, raw chicken from unit # 5

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): SUSHI RICE
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS provided TPHC form for sushi rice.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. Observed RAID ant and roach spray store in the employees restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination.CFM discarded RAID ant and roach spray. EHS provided training on use only approved pesticide methods.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed Squeeze bottles, working containers of seasonings, and bulk white storage buckets in the storage area without common name labels.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label all working containers and bulk storage containers with the common name.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window or door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means. Observed back door half open.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. CFM closed door.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed buckets and boxes of food stored directly on the floor in the walk-in refrigerator, walk-in freezer, and beverage (tea) buckets stored beneath the three-compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. By the next routine inspection, CFM will store all food products at least six inches above the floor on approved shelving or dunnage racks. KUMO ASIAN BISTRO (Inspection Date: 06/11/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping clothes store on the sushi counter
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Employee stored wiping cloths in sanitizer bucket.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Observed unit # 4 at 47F, and unit # 5 at 53F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.CFM will call technician to repair both coolers. The units will not be use to store TCS foods until repaired.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall. Observed women’s restrooms without covered receptacle.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. CFM will provide a close receptacle for women’s restroom

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the @SANITIZER@ at sushi station solution was measured at more than 200 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of @SANITIZER@ solution at @##@ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CFM diluted sanitizer to 100 ppm
